scope: synthetic PC evidence; no target or physical execution
reference_authorship: separately authored binary64 mathematical reference; no production calculations invoked

initial_conditions.exposure_history: explicit fresh synthetic initialization per CSV; continuity within CSV

coefficients: independently transcribed ZHL-16C with 5-minute compartment 1b, frozen tissue_reference.py and reference-provenance.json

ascent.reason: upstream integer 600/9 before conversion to float
ascent.segment_seconds: ceil(pressure_difference_bar * 66); <=0.0001bar has zero duration; <=0.05bar snaps to surface

stops.optional_safety_stop: none; fixture holds do not define mandatory expected stops

anchors: settings maximum predicted first-stop ambient pressure persists across accepted samples including surface intervals; gf-low depth is selected from persistent maximum if settings anchor >= ambient-0.15bar, otherwise current first stop; no reset at surfacing
ndl: GF high ascent feasibility, coarse 600s increments to 14400s; first violating 60s increment at <=7200s; previous coarse bucket above7200s except 14400s cap
ceiling: GF scratch left by schedule, normally GF high after final surface ascent; zero when upstream TTS zero; public binary-search lower endpoint has <0.01bar resolution and bracket [surface,1+max_depth_m/10]
tts: mandatory stop sum plus per-stage rounded travel; upstream zero on no-deco explicitly qualified; independent travel-only normalization reported separately and never written to upstream results
availability: initially unavailable except tissues; schedules unavailable before60 transition/underwater seconds, at surface, or NDL=TTS=0; NDL>=14400 limited; TTS or stop>=59940 limited; invalid actual exposure latches invalid via public contract tests

comparisons.quantized_values: Exact primary comparisons: a different NDL bucket or stop quantum is a discrepancy, not automatically accepted. Precision/threshold effects must be investigated and published without widening tolerances.
comparisons.ceiling_justification: 0.10m maximum binary-search bracket width plus0.005m binary32/tissue roundoff allowance; compare to independent closed-form ceiling using declared GF, not another binary search

coverage: 30m with120s descent and2100s bottom;160s ascent to6m,240s hold,20s to3m,900s hold,20s to surface
outcome_rule: All primary comparisons must pass for numerical acceptance. Known discrepancies remain visible failures. Passing comparison harness tests alone is not numerical acceptance.
